title: Lockdown Procedures
description: Plain-text reference on when to lock down, securing entry points, setting up a safe area, and barricade techniques at home or at work and school. Covers run-hide-fight, calling 911 when speaking is unsafe, children, elders, and pets, and verifying the all-clear.
shortDescription: Secure your home, workplace, or school against an outside threat
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
